items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: So Joe Glaser was back there and he asked me who did I want to play with, and I told him.

ctx.x: Was Louis Armstrong playing with the Louis Russell band? Was he fronting the Louis Russell band when you were playing with him?

No, here's what happened, I was playing with Louis Russell and they made a decision. Louis Russell was playing in the (Apollo?) Theatre and Lionel Hampton was (there.) So Joe Glaser was back there and he asked me who did I want to play with, and I told him.
